'''Matt Hempstead''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[June 2001 Normal tournament (30 June)]] on 30 June 2001, according to Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2547">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-30-geoff-doesnt-play-at-normald2547/ geoff-doesnt-play-at-normal], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 30 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-30-geoff-doesnt-play-at-normald2547/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
